Tests of whether a Load Data wizard step is complete

Source: R/wizard-step_status.R
step_upload_complete.Rd

Each function looks at a dataset and says whether one step of the Load Data wizard is done. The wizard uses them, through wizard_step_defs and compute_step_states(), to decide which steps are open and when Continue is enabled. step_shapefile_touched() is not a completion test: it says whether the user has done anything on the Shapefile step, which decides whether that step's button reads "Skip" or "Continue".

Usage

step_upload_complete(cd)

step_quality_complete(cd)

step_national_rates_complete(cd)

step_survey_files_complete(cd)

step_shapefile_complete(cd)

step_shapefile_touched(cd)

step_survey_mapping_complete(cd)

step_map_mapping_complete(cd)

Arguments

cd

The dataset, a CacheConnection object (the value of cache(), not the reactive), or NULL when no dataset is loaded.

Value

TRUE or FALSE. Every function returns FALSE for a NULL dataset, except step_shapefile_complete(), which returns TRUE. Otherwise each returns TRUE when:

  • step_upload_complete(): the dataset holds unmerged sheets (cd$wizard_parts) or merged data with at least one row (cd$countdown_data).

  • step_quality_complete(): the upload is complete and every check of severity "blocking" in run_all_quality_checks() has passed.

  • step_national_rates_complete(): every national rate named by national_rates_required_fields() and every survey estimate named by survey_estimates_required_fields() has a value, and cd$survey_year is set.

  • step_survey_files_complete(): the user has uploaded all five survey files (survey_fields).

  • step_shapefile_complete(): the built-in shapefile is in use, or the user has uploaded one and cd$shapefile_name_field is set.

  • step_shapefile_touched(): the user has uploaded a shapefile.

  • step_survey_mapping_complete(): a survey name mapping is saved (cd$survey_mapping).

  • step_map_mapping_complete(): a shapefile name mapping is saved (cd$map_mapping).

Details

The survey files, the reference estimates and the shapefile have built-in data for the dataset's country, so reading them from the dataset never gives NULL. The tests for those steps therefore use cd$is_default(), which says whether the user has uploaded something. The two name mappings have no built-in data, so their tests check for NULL: a mapping exists only after the user has saved the matching dialog at least once.

Examples

old <- options(cd2030.wizard = list(national_rates_groups = list(
  cd_wizard_field_group("title_upload_group_maternal", "sub_upload_group_maternal",
    cd_wizard_survey_field("anc4_prop", "anc4", "title_upload_anc4_survey"),
    cd_wizard_national_rate_fields()
  )
)))
cache <- load_cache_data(system.file("extdata", "kenya.xlsx", package = "cd2030.core"))
#> ℹ Loading Excel "kenya.xlsx" for parts
#> ! The following columns are empty: anc_1trimester, under5_deaths, total_deaths,
#>   ipv2, measles_cases
#> ℹ Successfully loaded and cleaned data
#> ℹ Auto-detect candidates (|group|): vaccine=19, rmncah=28 -> selected rmncah

step_upload_complete(cache)
#> [1] TRUE
step_quality_complete(cache)
#> [1] TRUE
step_national_rates_complete(cache)
#> [1] FALSE
step_survey_files_complete(cache)
#> [1] FALSE
step_shapefile_complete(cache)
#> [1] TRUE
step_shapefile_touched(cache)
#> [1] FALSE
step_survey_mapping_complete(cache)
#> [1] FALSE
step_map_mapping_complete(cache)
#> [1] FALSE

# no dataset loaded
step_upload_complete(NULL)
#> [1] FALSE

options(old)
